summary.suggested: The St. Louis Republican reported that Tom Allen and Ned Donnelly were sparring with gloves in the crib scene of "Tom and Jerry" at the Theatre Comique, a star engagement closing that week.

metadata.notes: masthead reads 'The St. Louis Republican, Friday Morning, March 24, 1876' (pg 5), so kept as printed rather than Missouri Republican

facts.fact: Allen and Ned Donnelly sparred with gloves nightly in the crib scene from "Tom and Jerry" in a one-week star engagement at the Theatre Comique, Pine Street between Third and Fourth, St. Louis
